$comment: Machine-owned outcome ledger for the registry crossfeed queue (registry-candidates.json). Written only by scripts/record-crossfeed-outcomes.ts (deterministic, no network, no LLM): a --snapshot step before the weekly maintain-registry agent runs, a --record step after. The agent consumes queue entries by deleting them; this log records what became of each one (landed, re-sourced, disputed, or unchanged) so /system can show the crossfeed working. A run entry is appended only when something was consumed.
